segment_captions.caption: C stands up from the couch, moving towards the table with a bowl in hand.

C bends down to pick up a small object from the floor near a cluttered desk. The desk has various items including a bottle of water, a cup, and some papers. C then moves towards a yellow table and places the object on it.
C picks up a green object from the desk and examines it closely.
C adjusts a yellow desk drawer while watching TV. The TV screen shows a sports game.
C adjusts a yellow desk drawer handle with his right hand while looking at the computer screen displaying a game.
C adjusts the position of a yellow box on the desk while watching a game on the monitor.
C adjusts the camera on the desk while watching the TV screen showing a video game character.
